newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil markets closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil markets closed for holiday.

text.p: Malaysian crude palmoil futures, physicals and palm kernel oil futures markets are closed from February 6 to February 11 for the twin festivals of Chinese Lunar New Year and Moslem Eid al-Fitr.
On Wednesday, palm oil prices ended steady on pre-holiday covering and firm fundamentals, after a slow day, traders said.
A crop report by forecaster Ivan Wong had no impact on the market since most players were already on leave.
Some dealers expect the market to open mixed after the long holidays.
Dealing was thin with volume on the futures market totalling 731 lots at the close.
Third month April futures saw some support at around 1,300 ringgit level and the contract closed three ringgit higher at 1,308 ringgit ($525.09) a tonne.
Physicals Feb (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,355 ringgit against bids of 1,347.50 after trading from 1,350 to 1,347.50.
